digest.component_or_area: external LLM integration test / provider matrix validation
propositions: The live external test tier's provider guard rejects openai specs because the resolver canonicalizes them to 'openai-chat:' but the guard compares literally against the family name 'openai'.
The credential lookup in _live_llm.py lacks an entry for 'openai-chat', causing live_llm_ready() to return False and all live tests on the openai arm to skip.

The unit-tier matrix gate was updated with _MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER to map 'openai-chat' to family 'openai', but the live external tier was not updated to use the same family/qualifier distinction.
The fix adds a qualifier-to-family mapping in _live_llm.py and updates guard comparisons to use provider family instead of literal qualifier prefix matching.
Red-to-green verification shows unit regression tests fail on unfixed main (configured_provider returns 'openai-chat', live_llm_ready is False) and pass after applying the fix.
The guard retains its true-positive detection: pointing the openai arm at a different provider overlay still fails, confirming no safety regression.
